title: Odile and the Uniform
author: Lena Okafor
blurb: Ivo Quintana, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
